chunks: He said: Allah refused except to oppose the timing set by those who fix times.

key_terms.اللَّهُ: Allah, the One whose decree determines all affairs
key_terms.الْمُوَقِّتِينَ: those who specify or determine times
key_terms.وَقْتَ: the appointed time or fixed date
key_terms.يُخَالِفَ: to oppose or act contrary to

ai.seo_question: What does this hadith say about setting a fixed time for the reappearance?
ai.summary: This hadith states that Allah opposes the claims of those who assign a fixed time to the foretold event. Its significance is that it rejects speculative time-setting and directs believers away from asserting certainty in matters whose exact timing remains with Allah.
